# Repository guidance

This is Basem Sufan’s static personal site, published by GitHub Pages from `index.html`.

- Keep it dependency-free: plain HTML and CSS; add JavaScript or build tooling only when a clear need exists.
- Keep project copy concise and mark projects as planned until a launch is verified. Never invent customers, outcomes, metrics, dates, or live URLs.
- Keep the visual design minimal and typography-led; avoid decorative chrome, gradients, and needless cards.
- Preserve semantic, accessible, responsive markup, visible keyboard focus, and reduced-motion support.
- Avoid third-party scripts, tracking, and remote fonts unless explicitly requested.
- No build or test runner is configured. After edits, validate the HTML and smoke-test the page over HTTP.
